summary.text: Judd Strom is a Republican state representative from Oklahoma who has represented District 10 since November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Strom assumed office in the Oklahoma House of Representatives on November 21, 2018, succeeding Travis Dunlap.
In 2025–2026 he is assigned to the Appropriations and Budget Committee and the Government Oversight Committee.
He advanced from the June 16, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Isaac Mattox in the general election.
